programme.title: Wes Montgomery, Pim Jacobs, Ruud Jacobs & Han Bennink
programme.sub-title: Guitarlegend Wes Montgomery in The Netherlands
programme.desc: Wes Montgomery: Live in '65 shines a light on one of the most unique and influential guitarists in music history. These beautifully filmed programs from the spring of 1965 feature Wes, in intimate studio settings, leading three different lineups through some of his best-known tunes, including “Four On Six”, “Jingles”, and “West Coast Blues”. This rare footage, featuring rehearsals, between-song banter, and closeup camera angles, illuminates Wes's extraordinary musical vocabulary and unconventional picking technique.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Laurent de Wilde
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Laurent de Wilde performed his tribute to jazz icon Thelonious Monk at Jazz à Vienne. Alongside bassist Jérôme Regard and drummer Donald Kontomanou, De Wilde gives a respectful and engaging homage built upon 20 years of study.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner, Avery Sharpe & Louis Hayes
programme.sub-title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner's first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson's and Art Farmer's Jazztet. He's also known for his work with the John Coltrane Quartet. Tyner's style is easily comparable to Coltrane's maximalist style of saxophone. Though a member of Coltrane's group, he was never overshadowed by the saxophonist, but complemented and even inspired Coltrane's open-minded approach. McCoy Tyner is considered one of the most influential jazz pianists of the 20th century, an honour he earned both with Coltrane and in his years of performing following Coltrane's death.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Paul Desmond, Dave Brubeck & Joe Morello
programme.sub-title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history. Captured at the pinnacle of their power and popularity, Paul Desmond (alto sax), Joe Morello (drums), Eugene Wright (bass) and Dave Brubeck (piano) explore the trails they blazed into the realm of odd time signatures with ‘Forty Days' and two versions of their groundbreaking hit ‘Take Five', as well as forays into world music with a unique exploration of ‘Koto Song'. Their intimate onstage chemistry and impeccable musicianship made the DBQ an award-winning jazz supergroup.

programme.title: Clark Terry
programme.sub-title: The Skymasters with Clark Terry - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, Dutch big band and radio orchestra The Skymasters took flight at the North Sea Jazz Festival in the Hague. Joining them is jazz legend Clark Terry on trumpet, flugelhorn and vocals in this exciting collaboration.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: I Wouldn't Give a Cripple Crab a Crutch
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential male jazz and pop vocalists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of “Time After Time” and “You Don't Know What Love Is", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium in 1964 and in Rome, Italy in 1956 respectively. Revel in Frank Sinatra's iconic version of “I've Got You Under My Skin". Immerse yourself in Dizzy Gillespie's dynamic performance of “Let Me Outta Here”, recorded live in Denmark in 1970. Enjoy Tony Bennett's unforgettable performance of “It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing)” at London's majestic Royal Albert Hall in 1974. Let the haunting beauty of Nat King Cole's 1957 performance of “Autumn Leaves” and Louis Armstrong's performance of “Basin Street Blues” from 1959 delight you. Dean Martin's smooth vocal stylings will enthrall you as he performs the jazz standard “Wrap Your Troubles In Dreams". Witness the electrifying energy of Sammy Davis Jr.'s performance of “Too Close For Comfort”. Join us for this unforgettable musical experience that you'll surely cherish!

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of "neo-boppers" that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot. While performing alongside Herbie Hancock, Sonny Rollins and Diana Krall, the Texan (born in Waco in 1969) turned leader has distilled some twenty sonic manifestos, going from orthodox and inventive jazz to funk or the hottest Afrobeat.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2 String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135 and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

Determined to prove he is a stork after all, Richard ventures south on an epic adventure, accompanied by friends big and small, to unleash his true potential and be reunited with his family.

Despite chasing him away, each night he returns. Soon Ted and George learn that no one else can see the mysterious figure dressed in centuries-old clothing his name is Gil Le Doux and he's searching for a way home.

Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

Joe. However, as Jake's behaviour becomes increasingly erratic and perplexing, a rift begins to emerge between them.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery, Pim Jacobs, Ruud Jacobs & Han Bennink
programme.sub-title: Guitarlegend Wes Montgomery in The Netherlands
programme.desc: Wes Montgomery: Live in '65 shines a light on one of the most unique and influential guitarists in music history. These beautifully filmed programs from the spring of 1965 feature Wes, in intimate studio settings, leading three different lineups through some of his best-known tunes, including “Four On Six”, “Jingles”, and “West Coast Blues”. This rare footage, featuring rehearsals, between-song banter, and closeup camera angles, illuminates Wes's extraordinary musical vocabulary and unconventional picking technique.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Laurent de Wilde
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Laurent de Wilde performed his tribute to jazz icon Thelonious Monk at Jazz à Vienne. Alongside bassist Jérôme Regard and drummer Donald Kontomanou, De Wilde gives a respectful and engaging homage built upon 20 years of study.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner, Avery Sharpe & Louis Hayes
programme.sub-title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner's first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson's and Art Farmer's Jazztet. He's also known for his work with the John Coltrane Quartet. Tyner's style is easily comparable to Coltrane's maximalist style of saxophone. Though a member of Coltrane's group, he was never overshadowed by the saxophonist, but complemented and even inspired Coltrane's open-minded approach. McCoy Tyner is considered one of the most influential jazz pianists of the 20th century, an honour he earned both with Coltrane and in his years of performing following Coltrane's death.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Paul Desmond, Dave Brubeck & Joe Morello
programme.sub-title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history. Captured at the pinnacle of their power and popularity, Paul Desmond (alto sax), Joe Morello (drums), Eugene Wright (bass) and Dave Brubeck (piano) explore the trails they blazed into the realm of odd time signatures with ‘Forty Days' and two versions of their groundbreaking hit ‘Take Five', as well as forays into world music with a unique exploration of ‘Koto Song'. Their intimate onstage chemistry and impeccable musicianship made the DBQ an award-winning jazz supergroup.

programme.title: Clark Terry
programme.sub-title: The Skymasters with Clark Terry - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1989, Dutch big band and radio orchestra The Skymasters took flight at the North Sea Jazz Festival in the Hague. Joining them is jazz legend Clark Terry on trumpet, flugelhorn and vocals in this exciting collaboration.

programme.title: Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: I Wouldn't Give a Cripple Crab a Crutch
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential male jazz and pop vocalists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Delight in the expressive beauty and emotional depth of Chet Baker's rendition of “Time After Time” and “You Don't Know What Love Is", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium in 1964 and in Rome, Italy in 1956 respectively. Revel in Frank Sinatra's iconic version of “I've Got You Under My Skin". Immerse yourself in Dizzy Gillespie's dynamic performance of “Let Me Outta Here”, recorded live in Denmark in 1970. Enjoy Tony Bennett's unforgettable performance of “It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing)” at London's majestic Royal Albert Hall in 1974. Let the haunting beauty of Nat King Cole's 1957 performance of “Autumn Leaves” and Louis Armstrong's performance of “Basin Street Blues” from 1959 delight you. Dean Martin's smooth vocal stylings will enthrall you as he performs the jazz standard “Wrap Your Troubles In Dreams". Witness the electrifying energy of Sammy Davis Jr.'s performance of “Too Close For Comfort”. Join us for this unforgettable musical experience that you'll surely cherish!

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of "neo-boppers" that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot. While performing alongside Herbie Hancock, Sonny Rollins and Diana Krall, the Texan (born in Waco in 1969) turned leader has distilled some twenty sonic manifestos, going from orthodox and inventive jazz to funk or the hottest Afrobeat.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2 String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135 and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Kiss
programme.desc: Kiss is one of the legendary groups in Hard Rock history. They have millions of fans around the world and over 100 million records sold. KISS confirms why they have been the best on the scene for nearly four decades, in a performance that made history, impressing an audience of more than 85,000 people, in a show of more than 2 hours and packed with hits, held at the Nurburgring, Germany in 2010.

programme.title: Paul McCartney
programme.desc: Paul McCartney presents this special performance of the US Tour, made in the United States, 11 weeks and 34 shows, playing great compositions of his solo career along with some Wings and Beatles songs.

programme.title: Snow Patrol
programme.desc: With their third album, 'Final Straw', selling a cool 1.5 million in the UK in its year of release, Snow Patrol's reputation as a remarkable band remains intact. 'Live At Somerset House' reveals why the band is praised for delivering fantastic live performances. It also places them at one of London's most gorgeous settings which complements the band's distinctive and provocative sound perfectly. Performing live for the first time with a string section, this amazing Snow Patrol concert, features all the key hits including 'Run', 'Spitting Games', 'Chocolate' and a blistering version of 'Tiny Little Fractures'.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Con 2 nominaciones a los Globos de Oro y con un trío cómico protagonista impecable, 'St. Vincent' cuenta la historia de un chico cuyos padres se acaban de divorciar. La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: El Benefactor
programme.desc: La historia de un nostálgico filántropo (Richard Gere) que se involucra y se hace hueco en la vida de un matrimonio recién casado, Olivia (Dakota Fanning) y Luke (Theo James), buscando con ello recuperar experiencias vitales que antaño tuvo.

programme.title: Más vale sola que mal acompañada

programme.title: Un atardecer en la Toscana
programme.desc: La ganadora del Premio Nobel, Maria Linde (Krystyna Janda), una mujer de espíritu libre que vive junto a su familia en la cálida Toscana, mantiene un affaire con un joven egipcio dueño de un hotel de la playa cercana.

programme.title: Irrational Man
programme.desc: El profesor de filosofía Abe Lucas ha tocado fondo a nivel emocional y se ve incapaz de encontrarle ningún sentido ni alegría a su vida. Abe tiene la sensación de no haber marcado la más mínima diferencia con nada de lo que ha emprendido en su vida, desde el activismo político a la enseñanza.

programme.title: Trust
programme.desc: Will Cameron y Lynn han criado a tres hijos despiertos e inteligentes, y todos tenían la sensación de que, una vez las puertas estaban cerradas y la alarma puesta, nada podía pasarles. Pero Annie, su hija de 14 años, empieza una relación on-line con un chicoy rápidamente se gana su confianza

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio

Convencido de que Novak es un fraude, el reportero estrella de una revista masculina intenta desenmascararla, haciendo que se enamore de él...

programme.title: Un hombre solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo cincuentón y venido a menos intenta superar los tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera, después de años de excesos en los que el dinero y el sexo, han marcado el inicio de una imparable decadencia personal y profesional.

programme.title: Deseando amar
programme.desc: Dos vecinos forman un fuerte vínculo después de que ambos sospechen de actividades extramatrimoniales de sus cónyuges. Sin embargo, acuerdan mantener su vínculo platónico para no cometer errores similares.

programme.title: Devuélveme mi suerte
programme.desc: Ashley (Lindsay Lohan) es muy afortunada, tiene muy buena suerte y siempre le ha salido todo bien. Pero un día, Ashley besa a Jake (Chris Pine), el joven con peor suerte de la ciudad, y sus papeles se intercambian...

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rob es un reconocido chef de Londres, su carrera es un éxito y la vida le sonríe hasta que un accidente acaba con la vida de su esposa. Superado por la tristeza, Rob pierde su restaurante y su interés por la cocina, hasta que animado por un grupo de amigos y su hija, decide empezar de nuevo.

programme.title: El abuelo que saltó por la ventana y se largó
programme.desc: El día que va a cumplir 100 años, un abuelo se fuga de la residencia en la que vive y de forma casual se ve inmerso en una delirante trama criminal. No gran cosa para un hombre que vivió los acontecimientos más importantes del siglo XX, conociendo a Einstein, Franco, Stalin, Reagan y Gorbachov. Un abuelo excéntrico que no está dispuesto a renunciar al placer de estar vivo.

programme.title: Acceleration. Velocidad asesina
programme.desc: Vladik Zorich, señor del crimen de Los Ángeles, desconfía de su mejor activo: Rhona Zyocki. La propensión de Vladik al poder, el control y la violencia lo lleva a secuestrar al hijo de Rhona. Para asegurar su liberación, Rhona es obligada a participar en una eliminación planificada de enemigos y aliados de Vladik. Mientras la vida de su hijo pende de un hilo, Rhona lucha por encontrar y eliminar a los adversarios más violentos y retorcidos de Vladik, en una fatídica noche.

programme.title: Girlhood
programme.desc: Para Marieme la vida es una sucesión de prohibiciones. Se siente agobiada por su familia, por la escuela y por...

programme.title: Love bite
programme.desc: La escuela ha terminado y el verano empieza en la ciudad costera de Rainmouth. Jamie, un chico de 18 años, deberá empezar a trabajar en el negocio familiar junto a su madre. Aburrido y agobiado, Jamie fantasea con escapar de allí hasta que de repente aparece en el pueblo Juliana, una guapa, inteligente y sexy viajante americana de la que se enamora inmediatamente. Pero hay un recién llegado más siniestro en la ciudad: un hombre lobo se alimenta de vírgenes, y Rainmouth se convierte en un coto de caza.

programme.title: Melanie: La chica con todos los dones
programme.desc: El futuro cercano. La humanidad ha sido destruida por una enfermedad contagiosa que convierte a sus víctimas en carnívoros implacables. Solo un pequeño grupo de niños parece inmune a sus efectos. En una base militar en la Inglaterra rural, se estudia a estos niños, que son capaces de pensar y sentir aún estar infectados, en la búsqueda de una cura. Melanie es una niña muy especial, que destaca del resto. Pronto decidirá su propio futuro y el de la raza humana.

programme.title: Amanece en Edimburgo
programme.desc: Dos soldados regresan a su casa en Edimburgo para reanudar su vida romántica y familiar.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba

programme.title: Una noche con mi exsuegro
programme.desc: Durante una escala en Los Ángeles, el Señor Gallo, un testarudo y siempre ocupado hombre de negocios, decide ir a darle una sorpresa a su hija Ginnie. Pero una vez llega a su casa, descubre que ella se ha marchado sin dar explicaciones.

programme.title: Un padre de cuidado
programme.desc: Tim Allen es Joe, un chico cuya vida ha ido constantemente cambiando para peor. Cuando el acosador de la oficina va demasiado lejos, Joe decide que es hora volverse a sí mismo de un don nadie en un alguien.

programme.title: Mi segunda vez
programme.desc: La ganadora de un Oscar Catherine Zeta-Jones (“Chicago”) da vida a una mujer que, tras descubrir que su marido la engaña, se va a Nueva York y allí se enamora de un joven que le hará descubrir que las segundas oportunidades existen.

programme.title: Adivina quién
programme.desc: Cuando Theresa trae a su prometido, Simon Green, a casa para el 25.º aniversario de boda de sus padres, se olvida de mencionar un pequeño detalle: es blanco. Decidido a romper el compromiso de su hija, Percy Jones demuestra que el padre no siempre sabe lo que hace.

programme.title: Uno Más De La Familia
programme.desc: Basada en el best-seller A Dog´s Way Purpose, la novela que narra las aventuras de Bella, una perrita que se embarca en una épica aventura de regreso a casa recorriendo un largo camino después de que la separen de su amo.

programme.title: Loca Navidad
programme.desc: Steve Martin interpreta al jefe torpe de una línea directa de suicidio. Al tratar de salvar a la caótica agencia de la ruina financiera, Martin debe lidiar con todo, desde cabezas huecas embarazadas hasta bailarines travestis. Haciendo una pausa en su búsqueda para salvar vidas, descubre que el amor puede estar delante de sus narices.

programme.title: El Extra
programme.desc: En esta divertida comedia, un extra cinematográfico soñador hace todo lo que está en sus manos para que una joven actriz consiga su oportunidad en el mundo del cine.

programme.title: El Señor Doctor
programme.desc: Cantinflas interpreta a un médico de pueblo que quiere viajar a la gran ciudad para aprender las nuevas tecnologías. Pero nada más llegar, Cantinflas pone patas arriba el hospital con su mentalidad pueblerina y se enamora de la hermana de su supervisor, quien cree que Cantinflas está demasiado anticuado.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 46, 47
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Entre Lobos
programme.desc: Dos misioneras huyen tras presenciar un asesinato y buscan refugio con exasesinos que les ofrecen protección. Sin embargo, para sobrevivir, deberán conseguir armas, enfrentándose a un mundo peligroso donde la fe y la violencia chocan.

programme.title: Winnetou
programme.desc: Mientras los assiniboins entran en guerra con los colonos, Winnetou intenta mantener la paz. Un petrolero sin escrúpulos, Bud Forrester, provoca ataques falsos para iniciar un conflicto y quedarse con tierras ricas en petróleo. Old Shatterhand, Winnetou y Lord Castlepool unen fuerzas para detenerlo antes de que estalle la guerra.

programme.title: El ángel vengador
programme.desc: Un predicador se convierte en cazarrecompensas después de que un grupo de refugiados que busca cobijo en su iglesia sea asesinado por una banda de despiadados forajidos.

programme.title: Río Lobo
programme.desc: Tras la Guerra Civil, Cord McNally busca al traidor cuya traición causó la derrota de la unidad de McNally y la pérdida de un amigo íntimo.

programme.title: Devuélveme La Vida
programme.desc: Una jovencita lucha sin cesar para salvar a su madre drogadicta de un peligroso inframundo mientras el Departamento de la Policía de Los Ángeles lucha por destruir ese mundo.

programme.title: Mi Angelito Favorito
programme.desc: Un ángel es enviado a la Tierra en varias ocasiones y no consigue ningún cambio positivo. A pesar de sus fracasos, el ángel regresa a la República Dominicana e intenta ayudar a la gente.

programme.title: Sobre tu mano
programme.desc: Sonia, actriz de teatro, pierde la memoria en plena función y empieza a creer que es una prostituta. Ernesto, su esposo, decide seguir su fantasía para guiarla con cuidado hacia sí misma, mientras ambos se adentran en un delicado juego de identidades y emociones.

programme.title: Jack Hunter y la estrella celestial
programme.desc: Jack Hunter descubre que el tesoro del faraón fue trasladado a Constantinopla. Reunido con Nadia y Tariq por la NSA, debe impedir que el arma de Osiris caiga en manos criminales, mientras la mafia rusa presiona y pistas lo llevan hasta un convento en Konya vinculado a la Estrella de Osiris.

programme.title: Mi amigo Blue
programme.desc: Una icónica historia de amistad entre un muchacho y un perro único y desgarbado que se convertiría en una leyenda australiana.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: A Valeria le ha cambiado la vida por completo. La separación de sus padres la ha llevado a trasladarse a Madrid con su madre. Eso supone muchas cosas nuevas. Casa, instituto, amigos…La cosa se complica todavía más cuando Valeria se ve obligada a asistir al grupo de terapia que organiza el psicólogo del instituto. Allí se encontrará con otros compañeros que también se ven obligados a ir pero lo que parece un mal comienzo paralajoven adolescente, no es más que el inicio de una increíble experiencia vital nuevos amigos, una ciudad llena de posibilidades, acariciar la madurez y sobre todo descubrir que el primer amor es bastante más complicado de lo que se dice en loscuentos de princesas.

programme.title: Red Dog
programme.desc: Adaptación de la novela Louis De Bernieres basada en un hecho real, narra como un perro kelpie australiano se une a una comunidad minera durante los años setenta.

programme.title: La abeja Maya. La película
programme.desc: La curiosa abeja Maya y su amigo Willy salvarán a la colmena de la avaricia del consejero de la reina y pondrán fin a años de hostilidad entre abejas y avispas. Maya es una abeja recién nacida muy vivaracha que no sigue las reglas de la colmena, entre ellas la de no confiar en las avispas que viven más allá de la pradera. Cuando desaparece la jalea real, las avispas son las principales sospechosas y las abejas señalan a Maya como cómplice del robo. Ninguna de sus compañeras cree en su inocencia y Willy, su mejor amigo, será su único apoyo. Juntos se embarcarán en un largo viaje lleno de aventuras hasta la colmena de las avispas para encontrar al verdadero culpable. Gracias a Maya y Willy por fin reinará la amistad entre todos los residentes de la opulenta pradera.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: Fahrenheit 11/9 es una mirada polémica y cómica a los tiempos que corren en EE.UU. Michael Moore retrata las elecciones presidenciales de 2016 y estos dos primeros años del mandato de Donald Trump intentando responder las dos preguntas más importantes de la era Trump: “¿Cómo demonios hemos llegado hasta aquí?” y “¿Cómo demonios salimos?”.

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: La Hermandad
programme.desc: En un apartado monasterio vive una hermandad de monjes benedictinos. Se ocupan de curar a Sara, una famosa escritora de novelas de terror y misterio, tras un grave accidente. Muy pronto Sara empieza a observar ciertos detalles que llaman su atención.

programme.title: Cuando todo esté en orden
programme.desc: Una película honesta y sentida sobre las relaciones entre padres e hijos y la devastación que suponen las drogas.

programme.title: Matria
programme.desc: Ramona vive en un pueblo de Galicia sumida en un contexto laboral y personal tenso e impredecible. Siempre sacrificándolo todo por el futuro de su hija Estrella, se verá empujada a mirar hacia dentro y a pensar que, tal vez, haya algo nuevo por lo que vivir.

programme.title: Seven Dorms of Death
programme.desc: Seven Dorms of Death tells the tale of a cursed stage play that is about to be performed at a New England college. Unfortunately for the director, the young cast, and anyone else unlucky enough to be involved with the production, someone has deadly plans for the play! Can a pair of homicide detectives and a student with psychic powers solve the mystery before it's too late'

programme.title: Bus Driver
programme.desc: Un autobús escolar que se dirige a un retiro sufre un pinchazo y se detiene en el rancho más cercano en busca de ayuda. El conductor, cinco estudiantes problemáticos y su ridículo profesor de gimnasia como acompañante se encuentran, en cambio, con criminales dispuestos a todo para que sus operaciones de drogas no sean descubiertas. Los estudiantes y el profesor son presas fáciles para estos delincuentes, pero entre ellos y una muerte segura se interpone una fuerza más decidida y hábil de lo que jamás imaginaron: el conductor del autobús.

programme.title: Bloody Hell
programme.desc: Durante un asalto a un banco, Rex, un tipo que suele hablar consigo mismo o con su conciencia, detiene a los asaltantes y, tras varios disparos, logra asegurar todo el establecimiento pero, desafortunadamente, toda la misión, a pesar de haber sido un éxito, termina de manera trágica, por lo que es juzgado y encarcelado. Tras cumplir su condena, se muda a Finlandia para tomarse un respiro, pero termina atrapado por una retorcida familia caníbal que esconde un secreto muy oscuro.

programme.title: La particula de Dios
programme.desc: El detective privado Ned Cruz recibe el encargo de encontrar a Lexi Persimmon, una stripper que ha desaparecido junto a un alijo de diamantes valorado en 30 millones de dólares. Cruz topará con personajes oscuros, algunos morirán misteriosamente, otros tienen entre manos planes siniestros.
